objective: The search bar leaves the top of the feed at every width; from 1152 px the home page has a right column with the search bar, whose results show there beside the feed.
acceptance_criteria: Start gate: FRONTEND-035 has merged to main. Test-first: commit the failing tests alone before the implementation; the implementation commit edits no test.

At every width, / no longer renders a search bar above the feed. The feed's h1 stays the page's only h1. /search is unchanged and is still how a phone or tablet reader searches (FRONTEND-035's Search links).

From 72em (1152 px) on /, HomeView renders a right column (the rail) beside the feed: the existing SearchBar, then, when ?q= is set, the rail results, then a slot that EVENTS-013 fills with recent games and that renders nothing in this unit. main on / is wide enough for the feed at --content-max plus --space-5 plus the rail at --rail-width; every other route keeps its own width. The rail is sticky under the header and scrolls on its own when taller than the viewport.

Below 72em the rail is not mounted at all, so a phone makes none of its requests. Mounting follows a small useMediaQuery('(min-width: 72em)') hook in src/routes, which listens for changes, so resizing across 72em mounts or unmounts it with no reload. Tests stub matchMedia and cover both sides and a change.

On /, submitting the rail's bar writes /?q=<trimmed text> as a new history entry and stays on /: the feed is not refetched, keeps its loaded pages and its scroll position. Back removes the search. On /search the bar still goes to /search?q= as today. An empty or whitespace-only submit does nothing on either.
If / is opened with ?q= below 72em, the feed shows alone and nothing is lost: widening shows the results.

The rail results are a section headed 'Results for <q>' (h2), with Accounts then Posts, each showing at most five from the first page of the existing accountsKey and postsKey queries, so opening /search?q= afterwards reuses the cache. Each section ends with a 'Show all' link to /search?q=<q> whose accessible name includes the section; there is no Load more in the rail.

An account row shows its Avatar and username as a link to the profile. A post row is compact: author, time, and text clamped to three lines, with the time as the link to /posts/<id> carrying the modal flow's state, so the thread opens over the home page. A row has no action controls.
A Clear search button removes q from the address with a new history entry and returns focus to the search box.

Loading shows the shared StatusLine; a failure shows InlineAlert with Retry for that section only; no match shows an EmptyState naming the query. The result count is announced once per search through a polite live region.
features/search imports only PostNode, feed/api and components/ui from outside itself, so search-isolation.test.ts stays green; routes/HomeView composes the features, and none imports another.

No horizontal overflow: scrollWidth equals clientWidth at 320, 360, 1024, 1152, 1248, 1280 and 1920 CSS px, each with a classic 17px scrollbar, with a 100-character query and long post text in the results.

Browser rows at 360, 1152, 1280 and 1920, light and dark, reported with measurements or NOT DONE: no bar above the feed at 360; the rail beside the feed; a search with both sections; no results; a post row opening its thread over home; Show all; Clear; back and forward; a resize across 1152 px; keyboard-only search; 200% text size at 1280.

frontend/src/test/bundle-budgets/FRONTEND-036.ts declares, in the test commit, every output the unit changes. Entry growth is at most 2 KiB raw and 1 KiB gzip, and no output reaches 500,000 raw bytes.
No new dependency, third-party request, image file, or raw colour or px font size in module CSS.
wiki/CodeContext/Modules/0x08-frontend.md 'Search' records the rail, the /?q= address and the removed home bar.
